name: Portland, Oregon (public open data)
about: Public layers from the City of Portland (portlandmaps.com) and Oregon Metro (RLIS). No sign-in needed. Coordinates in and out are WGS84 longitude/latitude.

layers.name: City boundaries
layers.description: Incorporated city limits for Portland and the surrounding cities in the metro area (Gresham, Beaverton, Lake Oswego, ...). CITYNAME is the city. A point that hits no polygon is in unincorporated county land.

layers.name: Portland City Council districts
layers.description: The four Portland City Council districts (1-4) in place since 2025. DISTRICT is the district number; pop_total is population.

layers.name: Neighborhood boundaries
layers.description: Portland's ~95 official neighborhood associations. NAME is the neighborhood (upper case); COALIT is the neighborhood coalition. Some areas are shared by two neighborhoods.

layers.name: Zoning
layers.description: Base zoning for the City of Portland. ZONE is the code (e.g. RM1, CM2, IG1) and ZONE_DESC says what it means. OVRLY/OVRLY_DESC are overlay zones; CMP/CMP_DESC is the Comprehensive Plan designation. Only covers land Portland zones.

layers.name: Tax lots (parcels)
layers.description: Every tax lot in the three-county Portland metro area, from Oregon Metro. SITEADDR is the site address, JURIS_CITY the city, A_T_ACRES the size, LANDUSE a short land-use code, YEARBUILT, BLDGSQFT, and assessed values (LANDVAL, BLDGVAL, TOTALVAL). PUBLIC_OWN/OWNERTYPE flag public ownership. Owner names are NOT in this public layer.

layers.name: Capital improvement projects (points)
layers.description: City of Portland capital projects mapped as points (a building, an intersection). Projects are split across three layers by shape: cip_points, cip_lines and cip_polygons. To find every project near somewhere, query all three. Bureau_Name is the city bureau; Status, Phase and the Est_Construction_* dates say where the project is; Estimated_Total_Project_Cost is the budget.

layers.name: Capital improvement projects (lines)
layers.description: City of Portland capital projects mapped as lines (street, sewer and pipe work along a corridor). Same fields as cip_points; query all three CIP layers for a full answer.

layers.name: Capital improvement projects (areas)
layers.description: City of Portland capital projects mapped as areas (parks, neighborhood-wide programs). Same fields as cip_points; query all three CIP layers for a full answer.
